"#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================
# Pre-push hook: Auto-backup Gemini conversation transcripts
# Runs before every 'git push' so conversations are always saved
# =============================================================

BRAIN_DIR="$HOME/.gemini/antigravity/brain"
BACKUP_DIR=".gemini_backup/conversations"

# Check if brain directory exists
if [ ! -d "$BRAIN_DIR" ]; then
    echo "[gemini-backup] No Gemini brain directory found, skipping backup."
    exit 0
fi

echo "[gemini-backup] Backing up Gemini conversations..."

CHANGES=0

# Loop through all conversation directories
for conv_dir in "$BRAIN_DIR"/*/; do
    conv_id=$(basename "$conv_dir")

    # Skip non-conversation directories
    if [ "$conv_id" = "tempmediaStorage" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    transcript="$conv_dir/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl"

    # Only backup if transcript exists
    if [ -f "$transcript" ]; then
        target_dir="$BACKUP_DIR/$conv_id"
        target_file="$target_dir/transcript.jsonl"

        # Create target directory if needed
        mkdir -p "$target_dir"

        # Copy if file is new or has been updated
        if [ ! -f "$target_file" ] || ! cmp -s "$transcript" "$target_file"; then
            cp "$transcript" "$target_file"
            CHANGES=$((CHANGES + 1))
        fi
    fi
done

# If there were changes, stage and commit them
if [ $CHANGES -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[gemini-backup] Found $CHANGES new/updated conversation(s). Committing..."
    git add "$BACKUP_DIR/"
    git commit -m "auto-backup: sync $CHANGES Gemini conversation(s) [pre-push]" --no-verify
    echo "[gemini-backup] Backup committed! It will be included in this push."
else
    echo "[gemini-backup] All conversations already up to date."
fi

exit 0
"

# =============================================================
# Pre-push hook: Auto-backup Gemini conversation transcripts
# Runs before every 'git push' so conversations are always saved
#
# Strategy: Copy transcripts, stage, and amend the HEAD commit
# so the backup is included in the push being made right now.
# =============================================================

BRAIN_DIR="$HOME/.gemini/antigravity/brain"
BACKUP_DIR=".gemini_backup/conversations"

# Check if brain directory exists
if [ ! -d "$BRAIN_DIR" ]; then
    echo "[gemini-backup] No Gemini brain directory found, skipping."
    exit 0
fi

echo "[gemini-backup] Syncing Gemini conversations..."

CHANGES=0

# Loop through all conversation directories
for conv_dir in "$BRAIN_DIR"/*/; do
    conv_id=$(basename "$conv_dir")

    # Skip non-conversation directories
    if [ "$conv_id" = "tempmediaStorage" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    transcript="$conv_dir/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl"

    # Only backup if transcript exists
    if [ -f "$transcript" ]; then
        target_dir="$BACKUP_DIR/$conv_id"
        target_file="$target_dir/transcript.jsonl"

        # Create target directory if needed
        mkdir -p "$target_dir"

        # Copy if file is new or has been updated
        if [ ! -f "$target_file" ] || ! cmp -s "$transcript" "$target_file"; then
            cp "$transcript" "$target_file"
            CHANGES=$((CHANGES + 1))
        fi
    fi
done

# If there were changes, stage and amend the last commit
if [ $CHANGES -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[gemini-backup] Backing up $CHANGES conversation(s) into current commit..."
    git add "$BACKUP_DIR/"
    git commit --amend --no-edit --no-verify -q
    echo "[gemini-backup] ✓ Backup added to commit."
else
    echo "[gemini-backup] ✓ All conversations already up to date."
